::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 11th [1887]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Dr Susan Walton
:::

Dear [Miss Harrison](people/person_2260.qmd)
I believe the letter is from you though it is not the usual signature -  I do not know if you mean the original first number of the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd)or the first number of the series -  I have only one copy of the first, and that it is in a bound volume and marked and I do not like to post it without being sure that it is what you want

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** With envelope addressed to 'Miss Harrison, St Cross, Weybridge' and postmarked Weybridge 12 October 1887.
